entry.name: mc.jit.peek~
entry.digest: Read matrix data as an audio signal  (multichannel)
entry.description: jit.peek~ reads the value of one plane of a matrix cell at the position specified by the signal inputs. This value is output as a signal. The object arguments are [matrix_name] [dim_inputcount] [plane].

arguments.name: matrix_name
arguments.description: The named matrix to access (default = none)

arguments.name: dim_inputcount
arguments.description: The number of dimensions in the matrix (default = 2)

arguments.name: plane
arguments.description: The plane in a cell whose value is output (default = 0)
